annotations.text:
BuilderForce — founder + investor

This is the CURRENT homepage, reframed — not a replacement. Same eight-beat order the real page runs (canvas hero → about the app → problem/workflow → platform tour → see it run → pricing → objections → the ask), same voice, same tokens from frontend/src/app/globals.css. What changed is who the copy is addressed to.

Static mockups, not a clickable prototype.

THE MENU, EXPANDED. All 25 destinations of NAV_GROUPS, grouped by the arc, each carrying its owning seat as a trailing dot — plus the collapsed 64px rail, a destination's sixteen-item vertical index, the public Learn mega-menu, and the mobile drawer. The Product mega-menu is shown open on the homepage header itself.
The same rail as a founder first meets it: rung 0 only. Rows appear as the company earns them rather than being dimmed and dangled.

THE ENTRY POINT. Founder objects on a pan/zoom board — company, live metrics, cap table, funding round, data room, a breached trigger — with the composer bottom-centre. Every destination below opens OVER this, never instead of it.
SlideOutPanel width="sheet" (25%). The board stays fully readable behind it — which is the point of the width scale: closing the panel is a decision, not a rescue.
width="wide" (60%). Sub-views are a vertical INDEX COLUMN down the panel's left edge, not a horizontal tab bar — fourteen items fit vertically and a tab bar cannot hold them.
width="full" (84vw), not 94% — a usable strip of canvas survives. The retention mechanic is visible here: a required document at 'requested' is a gap, and its category names the seat that closes it.
